query:
-- Fix Iowa: Joni Ernst is the retiring Class II senator, not Chuck Grassley
UPDATE senate_races SET
  incumbent = 'Open Seat (Joni Ernst retiring)',
  notes = 'Open seat — Joni Ernst (R) announced retirement Aug 2025. D primary June 2: Josh Turek won (64.4% vs Wahls 35.6%). R primary June 2: Ashley Hinson won (76.3% vs Carlin 23.4%). Cook/IE/Sabato: Likely Republican.'
WHERE state_code = 'IA';

-- Fix Montana: Steve Daines is the retiring Class II senator, not Tim Sheehy (Sheehy is Class I, up 2030)
UPDATE senate_races SET
  incumbent = 'Open Seat (Steve Daines retiring)',
  notes = 'Open seat — Steve Daines (R) withdrew from re-election on March 4, 2026 just before filing deadline. D primary June 2: Alani Bankhead won (43.7% vs Neill 32.9%). R primary June 2: Kurt Alme won (76.3% vs Calhoun 13.6%). Seth Bodnar running as Independent in general. Cook/IE/Sabato: Solid Republican.'
WHERE state_code = 'MT';

-- Delete the bogus California Senate entry — no 2026 Senate race in CA
DELETE FROM senate_races WHERE state_code = 'CA' AND id = 30001;
